newsitem.title: USA: Municipal Mortgage changes payout schedule.
newsitem.headline: Municipal Mortgage changes payout schedule.

text.p: Municipal Mortgage and Equity LLC, also known as MUNIMAE, said on Tuesday its board of directors authorized a change in the timing of the payment of dividends to the common shareholders.
Effective with the first calender quarter of 1997 dividends will be distributed on a quarterly basis -- a change from the semi-annual distribution policy which the company has followed.

The board also supported the same alteration in the timing of distributions to preferred shareholders, requiring an amendment to the Operating Agreement that will be proposed as part of the 1997 proxy.

A spokesman said the company's sole semi-annual dividend of $0.56 per share for the five-month period ending December 31, 1996 is payable February 17, 1997 to shareholders of record on December 31, 1996.

MUNIMAE, which started trading on the American Stock Exchange on August 30, 1996, originates, invests in and services tax-exempt multifamily housing bonds. MUNIMAE has assets of approximately $225 million, consisting primarily of participating tax-exempt bonds.
